name: BBQ Chicken Pizza with Red Onion and Gouda

components.name: BBQ Chicken Pizza

ingredients.name: Raw chicken breast (yields cooked chicken topping)

steps: Heat oven to 245 C, preheating a pizza stone or baking sheet if used.
Dice raw chicken and sauté in a small pan with 5 ml oil until fully cooked to 74 C. Cool and chop finely.
Stretch raw pizza dough onto a lightly oiled pan dusted with cornmeal, keeping a slightly thicker outer edge.
Spread most of the BBQ sauce on dough, then toss chicken with the remaining sauce and distribute across the base.
Scatter mozzarella, smoked gouda and sliced red onion over chicken. Bake around 14-16 minutes until crust is fully cooked and cheese bubbles.
Finish with coriander and black pepper, cut into four large lunch servings, and cool before freezing individual slices.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Published Sally’s pizza uses already-cooked chicken and store-bought or homemade dough. UNHANGRY explicitly supplies RAW chicken weight so ingredient scaling includes its cooking loss.
Planning: Secondary stovetop needed to pre-cook raw chicken; could use leftover pre-cooked chicken but raw equivalent required for shopping list.
Freezer: cooked pizza slices freeze better than refrigeration for later week, crust softens in microwave
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
